description: This file defines a grain interface for a chat system, including methods for retrieving, posting, deleting, and editing chat posts, along with serialization support for XDocument objects.

classes.name: XDocumentSerialization
classes.description: Handles custom serialization and deep copying of XDocument instances for Orleans.

classes.name: XDocumentSurrogate
classes.description: A surrogate struct used for serializing XDocument objects.

methods.name: GetChat
methods.description: Returns the current chat content as an XDocument.

methods.name: Post
methods.description: Adds a new post to the chat with specified GUID, user, and text.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the post identified by the given GUID.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits the post identified by the GUID, updating its text.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into an XDocument.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an XDocument into a surrogate for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the XDocument.
